ctx.x: Mutt, I just met once. And, uh, uh, I really don't know. I didn't know too much.
You didn't hear him play too much.

items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: But the next week, uh, Papa Mutt was there in the audience and he, he was visiting from, from the West Coast.

ctx.x: Bunk was supposed to be there regularly then. Yeah. It wasn't just as a start of special guest once a month or something.

No, well, it was, it was just a once a week thing anyway. Yeah. And, you know, it was like, it was like a jazz concert on a Saturday night with dancing. But, uh, uh, anyway, he told me to, to take over and I, I tried, you know, I did the best I could. But the next week, uh, Papa Mutt was there in the audience and he, he was visiting from, from the West Coast. And I guess he had heard stories about how Bunk was falling down on the job sometimes, you know, and, and he was probably hoping to, that he, uh, maybe be…
Yeah, he was trying to show Mutt how it should sound.
